blockerRemoved: The frozen source-only proposer surface now receives an exact bounded public task statement without researcher follow-up or evaluator disclosure.

guidanceChange.prior: The child surface contained immutable source bytes but no exact bounded task statement, so a future child would still require researcher follow-up.
guidanceChange.proposed: Freeze the exact public issue bytes before proposal, validate task/provenance bounds in the parent, and copy only public task input into the proposer receipt while retaining evaluator data in the parent binding.
guidanceChange.expectedBenefit: Let a future child identify the requested repair without additional researcher coaching while preserving evaluator separation.
guidanceChange.measuredMechanics: Exact prompt bytes and provenance passed validation; altered, unbounded, commented/closed, evaluator-bearing and execution-enabling variants failed closed; the proposer receipt matched the public prompt and excluded evaluator identities.
guidanceChange.rollbackCondition: Reject the task if prompt or public identity drifts, a solution becomes exposed before proposal, parent-only data reaches the proposer surface, or sandbox separation cannot be enforced.
guidanceChange.cadenceRationale: Useful bounded launch integration remains ready and no writer contention was observed.

largestRemainingUncertainty: Whether inherited training-only failure-analysis state improves descendant successor productivity on genuinely fresh tasks at equal total cost.
nextBlocker: Bind the now task-complete proposer surface to a child launch on a compatible exclusive-UID isolation host and prove evaluator paths are absent from sandbox mounts; explicit repair-resource approval is still required before any candidate trial.
